incident-bot: [ALERT] 3782109876 HIGH_5xx_RATE service=encoder-canary region=us-west spike to 18% over 2m, p95 latency 1.8s. Pager triggered.
ingrid: ACK. I’m on-call, checking dashboards.
maria: seeing CrashLoopBackOff on encoder-canary pods. SIGTERM timeout in logs. HPA shows min->0 then bounce. Grafana: https://grafana.company/d/enc-canary
akash: quick grep of image diff: new image `encoder:feat-buffer-3` added a `preStop` sleep 30s and readiness probe changed to `/readyz` (old was `/live`). liveness still `/healthz`. readiness mismatch + long preStop likely killing in-flight streams.
ingrid: customer impact? which tenants?
incident-bot: Top affected: api-key=acme-inc (~20% of error volume), region=us-west, endpoints /embed and /generate. Error class 503 upstream timeout.
maria: traffic routed to canary via feature flag `encoder_canary_pct=10`. Recommend flip to 0 now.
ingrid: doing kill-switch: `/ffctl set encoder_canary_pct 0 --source=oncall` — will post result.
deploy-bot: feature flag updated: encoder_canary_pct=0 (propagation ~10s)
akash: also recommend immediate rollback/pin. Starting: `kubectl -n ml set image deployment/encoder encoder=image:release-2026-01` then `kubectl rollout status deploy/encoder -w`.
ingrid: temporary HPA patch to prevent scale-to-zero: `kubectl -n ml patch hpa encoder --type=merge -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":2}}'`
maria: logs: 1) readiness probe failing -> connections dropped -> upstream 503s 2) SIGTERM not honored due to sleep -> process killed after grace -> client broken streams. Need to remove preStop sleep.
akash: pushed `encoder:hotfix-prestop` without sleep; prefer rollback to stable now. Applying rollout to release-2026-01.
sre_lead: hold on node drains — several nodes under memory pressure from encoder burst. Do not drain until replicas stable elsewhere.
ryan: I take next oncall in 10m. Handoff checklist: error rate <1% x15m, flag=0, rollout pinned, HPA minReplicas=2, postmortem draft opened, notify CSMs for affected tenants.
ingrid: status update: kill switch applied, rollback in progress, HPA patched. Monitoring metrics.
incident-bot: [UPDATE] 3782109950 error rate dropped to 2.3% after flag flip, p95 latency 1.1s.
maria: rollout complete: deployment/encoder now at image release-2026-01, all pods Ready (6/6). CrashLoopBackOffs cleared. No further 5xx spikes in us-west edge.
ingrid: reverting HPA patch after steady-state. Will set minReplicas back to 1 after 30m of stable metrics.
akash: opened PR #4823: fix readiness path to `/live`, remove preStop sleep; jess assigned for review.
ryan: ack handoff. I’ll monitor for 1h and start postmortem outline.
ingrid: customer-impact summary for handoff: ~12-minute window with elevated 5xx affecting ~8% of global traffic in us-west; primary affected tenant acme-inc (~20% of errors). No data loss. SLA risk: degraded embed/generate endpoints; CSMs alerted.
ingrid: marking pager resolved, incident mitigated. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: [CLOSE] 3782110048 Incident mitigated; please create postmortem and link in #incidents-postmortems.
